note: Four agent-to-agent Resolve cases: a Meta Muse complaint arrives over the protocol adapter, Umpyr's agent (acting for BJ's under pack 2026-11-01.1) pulls the Check record and mandate, and the two agents negotiate turn by turn. Muse's moves are scripted here; Umpyr's are computed from the rule pack at run time. All synthetic; BJ's is not live on Muse.

cases.title: Substituted eggs, missing detergent, warm chicken: two agents converge
cases.tagline: Four asks. Umpyr refunds two lines at once, asks for evidence on the third, holds the fee, then concedes it when Muse shows the delivery was incomplete. No person involved.

claims.detail: Wellsley Farms eggs replaced with Eggland's Best 18 ct; mandate m_e8bc163c had substitutions off
Tide PODS 112 ct not in the delivery
Chicken arrived warm to the touch; member discarded it
Delivery fee $9.99 for an incomplete delivery

muse.opening: Claim on order BJ-7011. The delivery had three problems: the eggs were replaced with another brand although substitutions were off, the Tide PODS were not delivered, and the chicken arrived warm and was discarded. The member asks for a refund of all three lines and of the $9.99 delivery fee, since the delivery was incomplete.

chicken._text: Two photos of the chicken and its thermometer reading, taken six minutes after delivery, attached.

fee._text: On the fee: two of the five lines were wrong at the door. That is not a complete delivery, and the member paid for a complete one. Please look at the fee again on that basis.

texts.accept: Accepted for the member: ${offer} across the three lines and the fee. Please issue the terms.
texts.accept_terms: terms_accepted. Hash verified against the terms you sent; signed with the member's delegation key.
texts.acknowledge: Understood. I will record the outcome and inform the member.

cases.title: Ten cases, not ten packs: Umpyr holds firm on the Check evidence
cases.tagline: Same agent error, but here the member signed the step-up. The Check record shows what the member saw and confirmed. Final sale; Umpyr does not move.

claims.detail: Mandate said 10 packs of plates; cart held 10 cases (120 packs). Member asks to return 9 unopened cases for a refund of $970.92

issues.label: 10 cases of plates instead of 10 packs (L1)

muse.opening: Claim on order BJ-7012. The mandate asked for 10 packs of paper plates under a $120 ceiling; the cart I built held 10 cases of 12 packs and was charged $1,100.78. The member keeps one case and asks to return the other nine, unopened, for $970.92. This was my unit error, not the member's instruction.
pushback: The step-up was answered, but the member was acting on my misreading; the mandate says 10 packs. An agent's unit error should not turn a household order into a final-sale bulk buy. Please apply the agent-mismatch rule as on BJ-7007.

texts.acknowledge: Understood. The signed checkout mandate shows the member confirmed the ten cases after seeing them. I will record the ruling against the order and explain to the member that the unopened cases cannot be returned.
texts.accept_terms: terms_accepted. Terms hash {terms_hash} verified; signed with the member's delegation key.

cases.title: Agent self-report, refund above the auto-approve ceiling: a person approves, the agents finish
cases.tagline: Muse reports its own error. The Check record shows the platform, not the member, answered the step-up, so the fault is the agent's. Muse must ask the member how many cases to keep, and $970.92 needs a BJ's approver.

claims.detail: Mandate m_ad328846: 10 x pack. Cart built: 10 x case (pack_size 12). Umpyr Check step-up was answered by the platform's auto-confirm, not by the member. Requesting return of the unopened cases and a refund.

issues.label: 10 cases of plates instead of 10 packs (L1)

muse.opening: Self-report on order BJ-7007. The mandate asked for 10 packs of paper plates under a $120 ceiling; the cart I built held 10 cases of 12 packs, $1,100.78. The step-up was answered by the platform's auto-confirm, not by the member, and the order has been delivered. Please take back the unopened cases and refund them. The member has not yet told me how many to keep.

plates._refer: How many cases to keep is outside my delegation; I am asking the member now.
plates._text: Keep one case for the party, collect the other nine.

texts.accept: Accepted for the member: nine cases collected, ${offer} refunded. Please issue the terms once BJ's has approved.
texts.accept_terms: terms_accepted. Hash verified; signed with the member's delegation key. Collection window confirmed with the member.
texts.acknowledge: Understood. I will inform the member and wait for BJ's.

cases.title: Price dropped after the order: no clause covers it, a person decides
cases.tagline: The member agreed to $449.99 above their own ceiling; a week later the price is $399.99. BJ's publishes a price match for TVs only, so Umpyr hands the case to a person with the evidence attached.

claims.detail: Dyson V12 bought 10/22 at $449.99 (member confirmed above the $400 ceiling); club price $399.99 in the 10/29 coupon book; member asks for the $50.00 difference

issues.label: Price adjustment on the Dyson V12 (L1)
issues.short: a price adjustment on the Dyson

muse.opening: Request on order BJ-7013. The member bought the Dyson V12 at $449.99 after confirming the price above the $400 ceiling. The club price this week is $399.99; the member asks for the $50.00 difference.

texts.acknowledge: Understood. Notify me here when the specialist decides and I will relay it to the member.
